title: Chile
goal: Read how Pinochet called an October 1988 plebiscite to project legitimacy, and how he stayed on as commander in chief in a transition many considered incomplete -- not the 1973 coup, already covered.

items: Describe why the Southern Cone nations seemed democratic exceptions before the coups.
Explain why Pinochet called the October 1988 plebiscite.
Describe how the opposition overcame its internal divisions.
Describe Pinochet's role after losing the plebiscite.
Use en aras de to name a stated higher justification.
I can describe why the Southern Cone nations seemed democratic exceptions before the coups.
I can explain why Pinochet called the October 1988 plebiscite.
I can describe how the opposition overcame its internal divisions.

I can use en aras de to name a stated higher justification.
